get_queue_length_time_series: get the CUDA stream queue length time series for specified ranks from a trace
get_queue_length_summary: get summary statistics of CUDA stream queue length per rank and stream from a trace
get_time_spent_blocked_on_full_queue: get the time spent blocked when the kernel launch queue is full for each stream
get_memory_bw_time_series: get the memory bandwidth time series for memory copy and memory set operations per rank
get_memory_bw_summary: get summary statistics of memory operations like MemcpyDtoH, MemcpyHtoD, MemcpyDtoD, and MemSet
